title: token.create
description: Create new tokens. A token created by this method also has to be generated (token.generate) before it is usable.

userid.description: A user the token has been assigned to. Default: current user.

status.description: Token status. Possible values: 0 - (default) enabled token; 1 - disabled token.

expires_at.description: Token expiration date and time. Zero for never-expiring tokens.
